directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write a news report to your campus newspaper on a visit to a Hope elementary school organized by your Student Union. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
sample_essay:
A Visit to a Hope Elementary School

Recently, the Student Union organized a visit to a Hope elementary school, which left a deep impression on all participants.

To begin with, upon arrival, we were warmly welcomed by the students and teachers there. We brought them school supplies like books and stationery, aiming to improve their learning conditions. In addition, we held various interactive activities. Some of us taught English songs to the kids, and others played games with them. The laughter and joy filled the whole campus. Furthermore, we had in-depth conversations with the students. We learned about their dreams and difficulties, and encouraged them to pursue their goals bravely.

In conclusion, this visit was a meaningful experience. It not only brought happiness to the students in the Hope elementary school but also made us realize the importance of helping those in need. We hope more people can join in such activities to make a difference.
